_comment: Single source of truth for model names and AI routing. Edge Functions and Python jobs both read this file. API keys are NOT here: GROQ_API_KEY / XAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY come from env / Supabase secrets.

chat._comment: Basic answers: assistant Q&A, voice/text command parsing, review sentiment, insight text. Any OpenAI-compatible API. Switch provider with CHAT_PROVIDER=groq|xai (env) or 'default_provider' below.

gemini._comment: Search and multimodal only: bill photos, voice audio, photo/product search embeddings.
gemini._embedding_note: Changing embedding_model or embedding_dimensions requires re-embedding the whole catalog (see docs/OPERATIONS.md). The DB column is vector(768).

ocr._comment: Local EasyOCR service (ml/ocr/server.py). scan-bill uses it when Gemini fails, is rate-limited or cannot read the bill. Leave OCR_SERVICE_URL unset to disable.
